title: Microsoft 365 applications hit by global outage for over 10 hours
summary:
While Microsoft said the outage happened because a number of servers had become unexpectedly unavailable, straining the remaining infrastructure, it also ascertained that it wasn't aware of any malicious activity was behind it.

The post Microsoft 365 applications hit by global outage for over 10 hours appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Microsoft 365 suffered a worldwide outage that kept Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and other core services down for more than 10 hours.
